title: analyze eval supp adapt tau025 spatial s44

content.text:

**3-seed 汇总 (τ=0.25, Spatial):**

| Seed | SR | Trigger Rate |
|------|----|-------------|
| 42 | 82.0% | 19.4% |
| 43 | 80.0% | 19.4% |
